messages:
maria: FYI hitting a repeatable failure with the sampleapp streaming demo when customers run it behind the corp proxy. The final event doesn't arrive and UI stays stuck on \"loading\".

sam: screenshots/logs? is this only in Node or browser too?

maria: Node sampleapp (express + node sdk v0.9.3). Works locally, fails through our corp LB. Proxy logs show the last SSE chunk gets cut off mid-boundary. Example from proxy: ```data: {\"choices\":[{\"text\":\"...token\"}]}

:``` — notice the trailing blank line/newline is missing.

jin: That will break our SSE parser which waits for "\n\n" to emit the event. If the LB strips the final newline the buffer never flushes.

sam: Can you reproduce with curl or socat? Might be easier to simulate keepalive truncation locally.

maria: Repro with curl + `--no-buffer` and `--keepalive-time` is trivial. I'll paste a minimal repro script in the PR.

jin: Quick fix idea: treat socket EOF/close as an implicit flush of any buffered SSE payloads. Parser should not strictly require a trailing blank line on close. Also add a configurable idle-flush timeout so partial events are emitted after X ms of inactivity.

sam: +1. That covers flaky LBs and mobile networks. Let's add tests: node/browser/python parity matrix and a small integration test that simulates truncated final newline.

maria: Agree. Also add a short troubleshooting note in sampleapp README about proxies that inject/strip keepalive bytes; saves customers a lot of time.

ops: deploy-bot: created branch fix/sse-eof-flush. CI queued. :rocket:

sam: Implementation notes — don't change normal path behavior. Only flush-on-eof and flush-on-idle if enabled by config. Default idle timeout = 500ms for now. Expose option in SDK init.

jin: Browser SDK: fetch streams behave differently since service worker/proxies may frame chunks; ensure behavior is mirrored. For browsers, we can detect stream closed and flush buffer similarly. Add e2e with headless chrome.

maria: I'll attach proxy log snippet and the curl repro in the PR. Also will add the README FAQ blurb.

devx-bot: CI status: build 4910 for fix/sse-eof-flush — tests running.

ops: deploy-bot: merged to main after green CI. Release note: \"SDKs (Node & Browser): SSE parser now flushes buffered partial events on connection close and supports a configurable idle-flush timeout to handle proxies that strip trailing newlines. See sampleapp README for troubleshooting steps.\"
